page.layout: One scanned image of a book cover: pale leather binding with stains, holes and a stitched spine edge. No printed text block, no margins with text.
page.notes: Image shows the outside of a limp leather binding (pale vellum or skin, with wear marks and two thong or lace holes on the right edge). No printed text on this scan. Dark background at the edges is the scanning surface, not part of the page.
